## Problem

What use case or limitation should this feature address?

## Proposal

Describe the API and behavior you would like.

## Alternatives

Describe the alternatives you have considered.

## Compatibility and security

Explain any impact on Laravel compatibility, caching, credentials, wildcard origins, or long-lived workers.

## Checklist

- [ ] This proposal is scoped to the package.

- [ ] I have considered documentation and tests.
